**Issue #312 slice A (role port) apply run — 30/36 tasks, blocked at commit gate**

**What**: Implemented Phases 1-3 (Units 1-3) of issue #312 slice A — the SDD role port — in worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-312, branch feat/issue-312-featsdd-role-as-port-per-action-executor. Strict TDD, all RED-first except roles.contract.test.mjs (structural exception, documented). 338 countable lines, 4557/4562 pass (5 pre-existing unrelated #637 failures). Stopped before Phase 4 (commit/push/PR) per explicit no-commit instruction.
**Why**: #312 needs a pure contract stating which inhabitant executes which SDD stage, with what agent role and abstract model tier — first real inhabitant is `plain`.
**Where**: brain/scripts/lib/stage-config.mjs (new), brain/scripts/roles/role-port.mjs + roles.contract.test.mjs + fixtures/stage-set-custom.json (new), brain/scripts/harness/{platform,cli}.mjs (SDD_ENGINES extraction), brain/scripts/harness/backends/plain.mjs (+declareRoles). Migration draft at openspec/changes/issue-312-role-port/brain-drafts/config-migrations-1.3.0.md (Tier 3, not applied — brain/core/config-migrations.mjs untouched).
**Learned**: Design D1's diamond-import-graph diagram implied role-port.mjs reads sdd.map via stage-engine.mjs, but D1's own prose says "neither imports the other" — the prose (a stated invariant) governed over the diagram; implemented a private inline sdd.map reader instead, skipped entirely when model_tier===null so the "no id was read" note stays literally true. Also confirmed #456's 1.2.0 migration draft is STILL unpromoted (schemaVersion still '0.10.0' in brain-config.test.mjs) — the D6 ordering hazard this draft warns about is live, not hypothetical.
